# Pinned local browser dependencies

Copied unmodified from the official npm packages with npm install --ignore-scripts: pdf-lib 1.17.1 (dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js) and fflate 0.8.2 (esm/browser.js). Both use MIT licences; bundled notices are retained. Files are renamed to .mjs for native modules. No runtime CDN or npm requests. SHA-256 checks are in manifest.json and verified by test-file-studio.mjs. Update versions and hashes together after reviewing upstream changes.
